design.title: Kefi Tech — Digital Engineering & Transformation for Manufacturing
design.style_name: Kefi Brand v5 + Visual Diagrams + No Selling Language + REAL Content
design.logo_discipline: ONE LOGO PER SLIDE. Only slides 1 (cover) and 12 (closing) get the actual Kefi Tech logo image. All other 10 slides use `KEFI TECH`. Foot-rail on EVERY slide uses the text wordmark.
design.design_notes: 12-slide deck for Digital Engineering & Transformation x Manufacturing. REAL content throughout — no placeholders. Each capability deep-dive has 5 real sub-services with industry-specific names and descriptions. Visual diagrams: capability map (slide 3), 4 capability deep-dives (slides 4-7), industry applications grid (slide 8), 5-layer reference architecture (slide 9), 4-stage engagement pathway (slide 10). Single-logo discipline. No selling language. Industry-specific content throughout.

slides.title: Cover — Digital Engineering & Transformation for Manufacturing
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Apply .brand-stripe (6px left edge, top 60% #004c97, bottom 40% #ff6c0e). Top-left: `` (240px wide) at top:64px / left:104px. Top-right: small JetBrains Mono 'DIGITAL ENGINEERING AND TRANSFORMATION SERVICES · 2026' in --text-muted. Center-left (~y=240): eyebrow 'KEFI TECH · MANUFACTURING' in --brand; huge display headline at --fs-display (64px) on two stacked lines (Sora 700/800): line 1 'Digital Engineering & Transformation' in --primary, line 2 'for Manufacturing.' in --accent orange. Below headline: thin --accent-bar (48px wide). Below accent-bar: a real subtitle in --text-secondary at --fs-h3: 'A capability brief on Kefi Tech Digital Engineering & Transformation Services for Manufacturing.' Right side: vertical hairline at ~70% width with three stacked JetBrains Mono callouts in --brand: '01 Product', '02 Cloud-Native', '03 Application'. Apply .grid-bg subtle background grid. NO secondary stat. NO CTA. Clean and quiet. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; right '01 / 12 · DIGITAL ENGINEERING AND TRANSFORMATION SERVICES'.

slides.title: Industry Context — Manufacturing
slides.task_brief: Industry context slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT · MANUFACTURING' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'Manufacturing is converging physical operations with digital intelligence.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Connected operations, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility and quality at scale define the modern factory.'. Below subtitle: a TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT column (55% width): a .surface-elev panel (~560px x 360px) titled 'WHY MANUFACTURING NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow in --brand). Below, a stacked list of 4 industry drivers, each as a small .surface card with: Material Icon (20px) in --brand + Sora 600 driver title (13px) + Inter 11px --text-secondary description (2 lines). Verbatim drivers — 'trending_up' 'Digital transformation pressure' / 'Enterprise digital adoption accelerating across the industry.' 'shield' 'Regulatory & compliance demands' / 'Industry-specific regulations require continuous compliance technology.' 'speed' 'Operational efficiency mandate' / 'Cost-to-serve reduction while maintaining quality and resilience.' 'group' 'Customer & employee expectations' / 'Modern digital experiences are now table stakes, not differentiation.' RIGHT column (45% width): a .surface-elev panel (~440px x 360px) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DIGITAL ENGINEERING & TRANSFORMATION' (eyebrow in --accent-dark). Below, Inter 13px --text-secondary body text (line-height 1.7): 'Digital Engineering & Transformation applied to manufacturing requires industry-specific capability, not generic technology. The right approach connects digital engineering & transformation to the regulatory, operational and customer realities that define manufacturing.' Below body: a small .tag-pill 'INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC APPROACH' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '02 / 12'; right 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT'.

slides.title: Engagement Pathway
slides.task_brief: Engagement pathway slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'A four-stage pathway from discovery to operations.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Each stage carries concrete deliverables, a fixed duration, and a transparent commercial frame.' 4-column grid of FOUR .pathway-stage cards (each ~270px wide x ~360px tall, gap-4). Apply .pathway-stage.accent to card 4. Each card: .pathway-stage-num + .pathway-stage-name + .pathway-stage-meta + hairline-soft + 'DELIVERABLES' eyebrow + deliverables list + .pathway-stage-fee at bottom. Verbatim — STAGE 01 'Discovery' meta '2 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Digital Engineering & Transformation maturity assessment', 'Opportunity prioritization', '90-day roadmap', 'ROI business case'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture', 'CoE charter', 'Governance framework', 'Build plan'. Fee: '$50K-$150K'. STAGE 03 'Delivery' meta '8-24 WEEKS · T&M OR FIXED'. Deliverables: 'Production system', 'Integration complete', 'Documentation', 'Knowledge transfer'. Fee: '$300K-$1M'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'. NO .pull-quote. NO CTA button. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '10 / 12'; right 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY'.

slides.title: Closing

NO top-right label. Center the slide vertically. Center-left composition (~y=240): eyebrow 'GET IN TOUCH' in --brand; huge Sora 700 headline at --fs-display=56px on two lines: line 1 'Let us engineer' in --primary, line 2 'what is next.' in --accent orange. Below headline: TWO contact lines in Inter 16px --text-secondary: Line 1: 'info@kefitech.com · www.kefitech.com'. Line 2: 'Bengaluru, India · Hyderabad, India'. NO .pull-quote. NO CTA chips.
